entries.principle: rot2-symmetric min-conflict walk on the pair field: B = -B about the centre (70-u,70-v); F(c) = #{ {P,Q} ⊂ B : c ∈ line(P,Q) }; cost = collinear triples = (1/3)Σ_{P∈B}(F(P)-(|B|-1)); move: take an orbit in a triple, re-place it at the orbit minimising ΣF (tabu 20, noise 0.1, two orbits w.p. 0.3), accept Δ≤0 else e^{-Δ/0.4}; when cost=0 record B and add the orbit with least ΣF among 400 samples
